name: Kingdoms and Castles Multiplayer (Beta)
description:
Steam-based multiplayer for Kingdoms and Castles. BETA / work in progress.

Host or join through a Steam lobby. Every player builds and runs their own kingdom on a shared map.

What works:
- Steam lobby host and join, with chat in the lobby and in game
- Shared map, with synced terrain, weather and trees
- Buildings: placement, construction, completion, demolition and keeps
- Villagers: spawns, deaths, and which house they live in
- Farming, fishing and livestock through the seasons
- Troops and combat: armies, ships, siege catapults, dragons and wolves. Every fight is resolved by one machine and the result is sent to the others, so both sides agree on what happened
- Fire and destruction
- Viking raids and wolf dens, shared across every player
- Diplomacy (Ctrl+Shift+D): alliances, war and peace, demands and offers, remembered across save and load. Alliance requests, demands and offers are answered in a popup
- Export prices (Ctrl+Shift+E): set what your kingdom charges other players for its goods
- Cross-player merchant trade
- Save and load a multiplayer session, and join a game already in progress

Known limits: witch huts are switched off in multiplayer; army positions are corrected in batches, so a fast chase can briefly look different on each screen; a big save takes about a minute to send to each joining player.

Created by BrassyCrane. Maintained by BrassyCrane, Mr.Sajtos, Bill Kerman and Bullofshiva.

These 0.14.0 fixes are by Bill Kerman: guests joining a loaded save, an issue that could stop farms harvesting, gold stuck at zero, the save transfer stalling, and kingdoms loading without their buildings. He also wrote dragon flight sync and the logic behind export prices, alliance offers and demands. Thank you, Bill.

Bug reports: please include your Player.log. Source and contributions: github.com/BrassyCrane/kingdoms-and-castles-multiplayer
